meta.note: ratio 为相对基线（20 步无加速）的实测采样段加速倍率；标 null 表示暂无可靠实测。Sage/Kitchen/SLA/VSA 为注意力后端，与步数蒸馏正交，可叠加（除冲突表标注项）。SLA/VSA 属稀疏注意力：序列越长收益越大，短片提升有限。

accelerations.name: TaoMate-H3 3 步（阿里 TaoLive）
accelerations.notes: 官方 runtime 验证环境 8xH20 96GB（分块流式）；社区 ComfyUI 转换版可在消费卡跑，逼真度/运动有损失
accelerations.notes_en: Official runtime validated on 8xH20 96GB (chunked streaming); the community ComfyUI conversion runs on consumer cards with some fidelity/motion loss

accelerations.name: 阿里 PAI PDD Acc 8 步（官方蒸馏）
accelerations.notes: 含 Parallel Decoding Distillation head bank，普通 LoRA 加载器会静默丢蒸馏头；CFG=1.0，euler + 节点输出的 sigmas
accelerations.notes_en: Includes a Parallel Decoding Distillation head bank; a regular LoRA loader silently drops the distillation head; CFG=1.0, euler + sigmas output by the node

accelerations.name: SageAttention（默认推荐开启）
accelerations.quality_cost: 极低（PSNR 30.3-32 dB vs 无 Sage）
accelerations.quality_cost_en: Very low (PSNR 30.3-32 dB vs no Sage)
requires: sageattention 包或 KJNodes Patch Sage Attention
requires_en: sageattention package or KJNodes Patch Sage Attention
accelerations.notes: 官方文档称可约翻倍；sm_120 长序列有静默噪声风险，长片段请用 KJNodes 或 Kitchen 后端并抽检
accelerations.notes_en: Official docs claim roughly 2x; sm_120 has a silent-noise risk on long sequences — for long clips use the KJNodes or Kitchen backend and spot-check

accelerations.name: comfy-kitchen 内置注意力（v0.32+）
accelerations.notes: 免安装、速度与 Sage 同级；不想折腾 Sage 的首选
accelerations.notes_en: No install needed and on par with Sage in speed; first choice if you do not want to bother with Sage

accelerations.name: SLA 稀疏注意力（Sparse Linear Attention）
accelerations.ratio_vs_en: Same config with SLA off: 1.4-1.75x (5090 768p/15s measured: per-step 44→31/25 s, sparsity 0.85/0.90)
accelerations.quality_cost: 低-中（必须成套使用 SLA 版蒸馏 LoRA；音频 block 保持 64）
accelerations.quality_cost_en: Low-medium (must be used as a set with the SLA-trained distill LoRA; keep audio block at 64)
requires: SLA 训练版 Turbo LoRA（lightx2v SLA 版）
accelerations.notes: 序列越长收益越大，短片（<5s）提升有限；最新 ComfyUI 核心 Block Sparse Attention 节点（comfy-kitchen ≥0.2.33）可直接切换该模式
accelerations.notes_en: Gains grow with sequence length; limited benefit on short clips (<5s); the latest ComfyUI core Block Sparse Attention node (comfy-kitchen ≥0.2.33) can switch this mode directly

accelerations.name: VSA 稀疏注意力（Video Sparse Attention）
accelerations.ratio_vs: FastVideo 官方 90% 稀疏训练；社区单卡与 FastH3 4 步蒸馏同用时已达 24GB 分钟级草稿
accelerations.ratio_vs_en: Official FastVideo 90% sparse training; community single-GPU use with the FastH3 4-step distillation already reaches minute-level drafts on 24GB
accelerations.quality_cost: 低（与 FastH3 蒸馏路线同源）
accelerations.quality_cost_en: Low (same lineage as the FastH3 distillation route)
requires: FastVideo VSA 节点（barelymining/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-FastVideo）或核心 Block Sparse Attention（comfy-kitchen ≥0.2.33）
建议搭配 FastH3 4 步蒸馏 LoRA
requires_en: FastVideo VSA node (barelymining/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-FastVideo) or core Block Sparse Attention (comfy-kitchen ≥0.2.33)
recommended with the FastH3 4-step distill LoRA
accelerations.notes: arXiv:2505.13389（NeurIPS 2025）；官方验证为多卡 + fastvideo-kernel，消费级单卡建议与 4 步蒸馏同用
accelerations.notes_en: arXiv:2505.13389 (NeurIPS 2025); official validation is multi-GPU + fastvideo-kernel; on consumer single GPUs pair it with the 4-step distillation

accelerations.name: EasyCache / Spectrum 步缓存
accelerations.quality_cost: 有（需 end_percent 修正并抽检）
accelerations.quality_cost_en: Yes (needs end_percent tuning and spot checks)
accelerations.notes: 与蒸馏 LoRA 可叠加；与 PDD 冲突
accelerations.notes_en: Stacks with distill LoRAs; conflicts with PDD

accelerations.name: CLIPCached 条件/潜变量磁盘缓存
accelerations.notes: 同一提示词多 seed：24GB 卡 950s→96s/条；TE 永远不重复加载
accelerations.notes_en: Same prompt, multiple seeds: on a 24GB card 950s→96s per clip; the TE is never reloaded
